cupra-born-light-detail:
Extreme close-up macro detail shot of the front headlight (or taillight) cluster of a CUPRA Born, using the provided reference image as the exact framing and crop guide — take only this detail section from the reference, do not show the full car or any other part of it.

Black and white monochrome photograph, selective color: only the light elements (LED signature) glow in saturated red — every other part of the image, including the car body, remains pure grayscale with no color cast.

Style: technical automotive detail photography, dynamic diagonal composition, highly atmospheric and moody. Shot as if captured on a Leica M or Hasselblad medium-format camera with a telephoto lens, aperture wide open (f/1.4–f/2), extremely shallow depth of field. Focus locked precisely on the glowing red lights — every light element razor-sharp with visible fine detail (lens texture, LED structure), while the car body surrounding it falls into soft directional blur.

Background: completely and totally out of focus, abstract soft bokeh only — no visible environment, no readable shapes, no context clues about location. Nothing but the light detail should be recognizable.

Mood: intense, dramatic, quiet power. Deep blacks, high contrast, fine film grain, no text, no watermark, no logos other than what is naturally part of the light housing.
